mapper.select:
SELECT T1.CASH_ID cashId ,T1.CCY ccy ,T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo ,T3.ACCT_NAME acctName ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate
,T2.BENCHMARK_ID indexId ,T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE indexSource ,T2.INT_TYPE rateType ,T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType ,T2.BASIS basis
,T2.RATE * 100 as rate
,T2.RATE as currentRate ,T2.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate
FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
T1.CASH_ID = #{cashId} AND T2.EFF_DATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo, T2.CASH_ID cashId, T2.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType, T3.ACCT_NAME acctName,
T1.INT_TYPE rateType,
CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN T1.RATE * 100 ELSE (T1.RATE*T1.COEFFICIENT+T1.SPREAD_RATE) * 100 END AS rate
,CASE T1.INT_TYPE WHEN '01' THEN FORMAT(T1.RATE * 100,5) ELSE CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(CONCAT(T4.ITEM_VALUE,'*'),T1.COEFFICIENT),'+'),FORMAT(T1.SPREAD_RATE*100,7)) END AS rateStr
,T2.CCY ccy ,T1.EFF_DATE effDate ,if(@ACCT_NO=T3.ACCT_NO,@rank:=@rank+1,@rank:=1) as rum_num ,@rownum:=@rownum+1 rownum, @ACCT_NO=T3.ACCT_NO FROM (select @rownum:=0,@ACCT_NO:=null,@rank:=0)b, FIN_RATE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T2 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID
LEFT JOIN SYS_DATADICT_LIST T4 ON T4.DICT_CODE = 'SECRATE_DATA' AND T1.BENCHMARK_ID = T4.ITEM_CODE
INNER JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T2.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
AND (T1.EFF_DATE BETWEEN STR_TO_DATE(#{effDateStart},'%Y-%m-%d') AND STR_TO_DATE(#{effDateEnd},'%Y-%m-%d'))
AND T3.ACCT_NO = #{busiAcctNo}
order by T3.ACCT_NO,T1.EFF_DATE
SELECT CLOSE_PRICE FROM MST_EXPONENT_QUOTATION WHERE MARKET_ID = #{indexId} AND EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY EFF_DATE DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT YIELD FROM MST_YIELD_CURVE_INFO WHERE CURVE_CODE = #{indexId} AND CURVE_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY CURVE_DATE DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CASE T1.BENCHMARK_ID WHEN NULL THEN NULL
ELSE T1.BENCHMARK_ID END AS indexId
,T1.INT_TYPE rateType
,T2.INT_RATE * 100 rate ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate ,T1.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T1.SPREAD_RATE * 100 spreadRate FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T1 LEFT JOIN MST_INT_RATE_INFO T2 ON T1.BENCHMARK_ID = T2.INT_RATE_ID
AND T2.EFF_DATE >= (SELECT MAX(EFF_DATE) FROM MST_INT_RATE_INFO T3 WHERE T3.INT_RATE_ID = T1.BENCHMARK_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate},'%Y-%m-%d')) AND T2.EFF_DATE <= STR_TO_DATE(#{platDate},'%Y-%m-%d')
AND T1.CASH_ID = #{cashId}
order by T2.EFF_DATE desc

SELECT * FROM( SELECT T1.CASH_ID cashId ,T1.CCY ccy ,T3.ACCT_NO busiAcctNo ,T3.ACCT_NAME acctName ,T2.EFF_DATE effDate ,T2.BENCHMARK_ID indexId ,T2.BENCHMARK_TYPE indexSource ,T2.INT_TYPE rateType ,T1.FINPROD_TYPE finprodType ,T2.BASIS basis
,T2.RATE * 100 as rate
,T2.RATE as currentRate ,T2.COEFFICIENT coefficient ,T2.SPREAD_RATE*100 spreadRate
FROM FIN_RATE_INFO T2 LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO T1 ON T1.CASH_ID = T2.CASH_ID LEFT JOIN STL_CAPACCT_INFO T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.ACCT_NO
1=1 AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND T2.EFF_DATE != STR_TO_DATE(#{effDate,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%Y-%m-%d')
ORDER BY T2.eff_Date DESC ) WHERE LIMIT 1
